Others on 16 February, 2024

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:27077
Court No. - 68
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53659 of 2023
Applicant :- Ramanand Vishwakarma Alias Monu Vishwakarma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Kumar Vishwakarma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Babita Upadhyay,Sarfaraj Ahamad Siddiquei,Suhel Akhta
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Babita Upadhyay, learned counsel for the High Court Legal Services Committee, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 79 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504 I.P.C., 3(2) (5a) of SC/ST Act and 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Lalapur, District Prayagraj, during pendency of the trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The applicant was released on interim bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, vide Ramanand Vishwakarma Alias Monu ... vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189117426/
1 order dated 21.12.2023.

entities.text: Ramanand Vishwakarma Alias Monu ... vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submitted that after being released on interim bail the applicant has not misused the liberty of interim bail.
He further submitted that as per the ossification test report, victim is aged about 17 years.

He next submitted that the Co-ordinate Bench after considering the entire facts of the case and appreciating the evidences, released the applicant on interim bail and no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the instant bail application pending.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 13.07.2023 and in case, he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for regular bail.

6. Since the applicant has already been released on interim bail, therefore, there is no need to furnish any further personal bond and on the same terms and conditions of the order dated 21.12.2023 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the applicant-Ramanand Vishwakarma Alias Monu Vishwakarma is released on regular bail in the aforesaid case crime.
7.

Office is directed to return the original copy of Ossification Test Report to the court concerned,
after retaining the photocopy of the same on record.

Order Date :- 16.2.2024 Aditya  Ramanand Vishwakarma Alias Monu ... vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189117426/
